title: Dedel SMP
description: A modpack focused on exploration, creativity, and improved world generation. It adds new biomes, enhanced structures, and additional gameplay features while keeping the core Minecraft experience familiar.
body:
This modpack focuses on exploration, performance, world generation, and technical gameplay while keeping the core Minecraft experience familiar.

It includes improved biomes and structures, optimization mods for smoother gameplay, and a selection of tech and quality of life mods for both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds.

The pack is designed for players who enjoy exploring, building automated systems, and playing long-term survival worlds with friends.

⚙️ Features

- Improved world generation with new biomes and structures
- Technical and automation focused gameplay
- Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay
- Visual and quality of life improvements
- Multiplayer friendly

Recommended to allocate at least 8GB of RAM for the best experience.
